body: Aman's point 3. Same mechanism as the deleted 'use here', but comprehensible because it is offered on a row that already reads 'signed in - 4 cookies - 2h ago', and named after the outcome rather than the plumbing. Must bounce through about:blank: a same-URL change is a fragment navigation and the shim would never re-run. Spec section 7.4.
title: Verb: open a session into the CURRENT tab
